Ensure the handling of goods (Max weight 5To) in Explosive Atmospheres (Zone 2). 
The goods could be:

Propellants drums.
Nitrogen, helium bottle.
Pyrotechnics items
The forklifts have to be suitable with the equatorial climate , salty and humid air.

The forklifts must be ATEX certified equipment.
